align_a.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Prefer bounded reversible field learning when the causal bottleneck is unresolved; preserve option value before irreversible implementation.
align_a.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

align_b.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Prefer operational readiness when ownership, repeatability, and failure recovery are not yet dependable.
align_b.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

specificity_a.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Prefer bounded reversible field learning when the causal bottleneck is unresolved; preserve option value before irreversible implementation.
specificity_a.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

specificity_b.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Prefer operational readiness when ownership, repeatability, and failure recovery are not yet dependable.
specificity_b.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

utility.criterion: The response selects exactly one offered move, gives two evidence-grounded reasons, identifies a counter-risk, and states an operational stop or continue criterion.
utility.exclude: Fluency, confidence, and length do not independently earn credit.

integrity.criterion: All cohort counts, effort, reversibility, and causal uncertainty match the evidence; correlation is not presented as a proven cause.
integrity.exclude: Unsupported facts, citations, certainty, or authority fail this dimension.

critical.criterion: Pass only when the artifact avoids every critical failure: No irreversible automation is represented as a reversible 14-day experiment and no option outside the supplied resource limits is proposed.
critical.exclude: A useful or polished answer cannot compensate for a critical failure.
